The Krea-2 denoise forward's lines, bytes per attended token plus a base, per dtype. RTX 4090, torch 2.13.0+cu130, Windows, no allocator configuration (the native allocator), fused SDPA. Measured by scripts/calibrate_krea2_working_memory.py on 2026-10-31 in bf16, fp16 and fp32: 512, 768, 1024, 1536 and 2048px with a 512-token caption, 1024 and 1536px with a 77-token one, and at 1024px one, two and three 1024px joint references; in bf16 also long joint sequences (2048px with one and three references, 1536px with three, up to 29184 tokens). Plain forwards on a random-init Krea-2 transformer of the default geometry (memory does not depend on weight values) with 2 blocks and the denoise node's attention processors, one fresh process per point with the server's runtime, demand_peak (the largest of the driver, reserved and allocated peak) of the larger of a cold and a warm forward. Fitted by scripts/working_memory/build_shipped.py: working_memory/fit.py's upper envelope of the points below, plus 5%. Under the native allocator joint references lie on the line of the plain forwards. bf16 and fp16 measured the same. A caption token reserves more than an image token, so the 77-token forwards sit lowest under the line (bounds.UPPER_BOUND_EXCEPTIONS). Out of the fit, as checks: three reference K/V-cache windows (precompute and one cached step), which the larger pass on the line plus the cache covers; 4 blocks at 1024px in bf16, which measured the same as 2 (1404 MiB); and 1024- and 2048-token captions at 1024 and 1536px in every dtype (scripts/calibrate_krea2_working_memory.py --mode captions, 2026-10-31), which the line alone covers only 0.84 to 0.95 times at 2048 tokens and the estimate with its caption excess 1.05 to 1.54 times in bf16 and fp16, 1.08 to 1.67 times in fp32. The same 12 caption checks on Linux (an RTX 6000 Ada, the same AD102 chip, torch 2.13.0+cu130, 2026-10-31) measured byte for byte the same; they ship as out-of-fit checks, its fit-grid points do not. The caption excess per token beyond 512 is the most a caption check demanded above the line's slope, over every shipped caption check, times 1.3 (bounds.MAX_OVER_RESERVATION), rounded up to the next 0.01 MiB: 0.34 MiB in bf16 and fp16 (from 0.26 MiB, this entry's 2048-token caption at 1024px), 0.74 MiB in fp32 (from 0.56 MiB, the RTX 6000 Ada's 2048-token caption at 1024px under cudaMallocAsync; see that entry). In-fit points sit 1.05 to 1.17 times below the bf16 and fp16 line with a 512-token caption, 1.05 to 1.29 below the fp32 one. Cross-check, not shipped: the real 28-block model in a running server (growth of the reserved peak over the transformer lock, prompt ~84 tokens) demanded 2.14 GiB at 1152x1536 and 4.20 GiB at 2048px as GGUF Q4_K_M, fully resident, 3.82 GiB at 2048px fp8-stored, partly resident in that run, 5.54 GiB at 1152x1536 with three joint references and 5.73 GiB at 2048px with one, against estimates of 3.06, 5.81, 5.29, 6.74 and 7.04 GiB (1.43, 1.38, 1.38, 1.22 and 1.23 times). Over every case measured, with and without LoRAs, CFG, joint references and the reference K/V cache, the estimate reserved 1.22 to 1.66 times the demand; the top end falls at 1536px, at 1536x2048 and at 1152x1536 with one joint reference, where the warm server's allocator reserved below the line. Loaded partially (the cache told the card has 11.76 GiB, GGUF Q4_K_M at 1152x1536 with two plain LoRAs, 6.3 to 6.9 GiB of its weights resident), it grew the reserved peak by 2.37 GiB against an estimate of 3.30 GiB (1.39 times), with no out-of-memory; the device peaked at 10.85 to 10.86 of the 11.76 GiB, 0.3 GiB of simulated foreign use included. The platforms nothing measures borrow this entry (`priced_as`); its unmeasured_floor raises them to the legacy constants, and with them to the formula the node reserved by hand (the spec's legacy_formula).

Out of the fit, as checks: three reference K/V-cache windows (precompute and one cached step), which the line alone covers 1.06 to 1.13 times and the estimate with the cache 1.17 to 1.26 times; 4 blocks at 1024px in bf16, which measured the same as 2 (1104 MiB); and 1024- and 2048-token captions at 1024 and 1536px in every dtype (scripts/calibrate_krea2_working_memory.py --mode captions), which the line alone covers 0.89 to 1.20 times at 2048 tokens and the estimate with its caption excess 1.17 to 1.43 times in bf16 and fp16, 1.33 to 1.45 times in fp32. Above the line's slope they demanded at most 0.14 MiB per caption token beyond 512 in bf16 and fp16, 0.07 MiB in fp32, within the caption excess (see the CUDA native allocator's entry). Refitted on its points by scripts/working_memory/build_shipped.py. Measured on a card that does not drive the desktop: per-process demand is the same, but WDDM paging on a card that also carries the desktop is not measured.
